fact: The Ninacad-Adresse digital parcel database and app was presented in March 2025 and covers about 1,500,000 places/parcels in Bamako's six communes, parts of Kati cercle and Ségou, with Koulikoro and Sikasso under way.
title: Digitalisation de l'Administration : Ninacad-adresse pour vite géolocaliser les parcelles
